method: Live measurement against the local FastAPI backend (uvicorn) with frozen artifacts. 300-row DEL-01 OOD replay plus a dedicated 20-row timing sample, both at requested speed 3600x over ws://localhost:8000/api/v1/live.
environment: Windows 11, Python 3.14, TensorFlow CPU-only, single local machine (backend and measuring client on the same host).

per_reading_s.note: Client-observed inter-arrival gap on 20 normal rows at requested 3600x; includes one TF predict call plus socket overhead per row. Anomalous rows cost more (SHAP).

speed_note: Requested 3600x could not be fully sustained (per-row inference, especially LSTM/SHAP on anomalous rows); the engine reported the achieved 2680x effective speed instead of pretending.
